title: Place & Time Ceramic 16oz Red Cocoa for Santa Coffee Mug Cup
descriptionText:
Enjoy your hot or cold beverage in style with this beautiful red ceramic coffee mug from Place & Time. The mug features a painted design of Santa Claus, making it a perfect addition to your Christmas or winter collection. With a capacity of 16oz and a height of 4 inches, it's the perfect size for your daily coffee or tea. 

The mug is dishwasher safe and comes with a solid color pattern, making it a great gift for teens, unisex adults, and unisex kids. It's an original and licensed reproduction from the PLACE & TIME franchise, manufactured in China in 2024. The mug is round in shape and has a diameter of 3.5 inches, with a normal glass type and no lid type. Add this unique piece to your collection today!
